built_by: The guarded workflow .github/workflows/fly-pilot.yml, run 35763623051, dispatched on main with operation deploy, after the continuous integration run 35731949431 passed on this exact revision.
what_this_release_changes: The owner's public voice reaches the live site: the headline, the first navigation item Get started, and no pilot or beta wording on customer pages. It also carries everything merged to main from 81f341d to 15d3659: the intelligence family serving policy (harness family by default), the starter catalogue reclassified as harness material with its 43 approvals carried across the re-anchor, the retirement of the parked in-process suites from the self-test, and the repaired sign-up, recovery and promotion routes (switched off by host configuration).

post_deploy_steps.why: The release image carries re-anchored catalogue bodies. Their disclosure grants must be applied to existing tenants after the deploy; the guarded workflow does not do it. Before this step the library offered 0 items.
The diagnostic keys issued on 2026-09-21 had the default 24 hour life and expired at 12:15 UTC on 2026-09-22, before this release. Not a regression of the release.

post_deploy_steps.step: Added http.request_limits {record_type service_request_limits/v1, client_address_source header, client_address_header Fly-Client-IP} to /data/host.json, then restarted the machine
post_deploy_steps.why: The failed-attempt limit for each client address was built but inactive in production (persona QA finding 10), and releases after e505eca refuse a public binding without it.
post_deploy_steps.evidence: 32 requests with a wrong key, each with a different forged Fly-Client-IP and X-Forwarded-For header, answered 401 thirty times and then 429 failed_attempt_limit_reached: the Fly proxy overwrites the header, so a forged address does not evade the count.

after_release.service_checks: 14/14 API checks; the MCP stage was run separately

known_gaps: baltor-pilot.fly.dev fails one browser check because the page shows its own host name, which contains the word pilot. The canonical origin in /data/host.json is still baltor-pilot.fly.dev; moving it to app.baltor.ai needs the identity provider's redirect list changed first.
demo, examples, docs and status .baltor.ai serve the main site; the per-hostname surfaces are not on main yet.
The guarded workflow does not run apply-grants; a catalogue-changing release needs it as a recorded post-deploy step until it is automated.
